text: SUPERVISOR DISPATCH — TESTPROBE-0606, a test-suite quality audit ordered by the user, verbatim: "have them run existing test, and then radically change something about the code that produces the same test result, from another approach, does the test work. if not, tests we are using are bad." The principle under test: a good test asserts BEHAVIOR at the consumption layer; if a behavior-preserving reimplementation breaks the test, the test is implementation-coupled and therefore bad. ISOLATION IS MANDATORY: the user's dev server hot-reloads every save in the main tree into their live session, and other lanes are mid-flight there. Create a git worktree first (git worktree add /tmp/testprobe-0606 HEAD) and do ALL probe work inside it; never edit the main tree at /home/siah/creative/reactjit. Note the main tree carries uncommitted work — your worktree at HEAD will not have it; that is fine, probe committed behavior only. Procedure, per probe: 1. Pick a test suite in UNOCCUPIED territory — avoid editors/paint/*, framework/gpu/paintable*, runtime/hooks/usePaintable.ts, PaintSurface/PlayRoute, workbench/characters/*, clothing, framework/game/physics.zig (all have active lanes). Good candidate areas: sculpt smoothing, camera, mesh, animation, settings, store core. Pick 3 suites that look load-bearing. 2. Run the suite, confirm green, record the command + result. 3. Radically reimplement the code under test with a DIFFERENT approach that preserves observable behavior — not a refactor-rename, a genuinely different algorithm/structure producing the same outputs. State in your notes why it is behaviorally equivalent. 4. Re-run the suite. GREEN = the test asserts behavior (good test). RED = the test was asserting implementation details (bad test) — record exactly which assertion broke and what it was coupled to. 5. Reset the worktree between probes (git checkout -- . inside the worktree only). Deliverable: a report per probe — suite name, what you reimplemented and how the approach differed, green/red verdict, and for every RED: what the assertion was coupled to and what a behavior-layer assertion should check instead. End with an overall verdict on suite quality and the list of bad tests. Cleanup: remove the worktree when done (git worktree remove /tmp/testprobe-0606 --force). Do this work yourself in your own context — no subagents, ever. /hand-over at 55-60% context. Do not commit anything, in either tree.
